title: 2025 世界愛滋日：篩檢、治療、不歧視
summary: 2025 年世界愛滋日活動專區（2025-11-15 至 12-15）：推廣匿名篩檢、U=U 與反歧視，活動已結束，頁面保留作為紀錄。
note: 活動已於 2025-12-15 結束，專區保留為紀錄；reviewPeriodMonths 設 0（不再定期審閱）；連結待權責單位確認深層網址
introMarkdown:
**本活動已於 2025 年 12 月 15 日結束**，以下內容保留作為紀錄；最新服務請見「性傳染病匿名諮詢與篩檢」專區。

2025 年世界愛滋日，疾管署以「篩檢、治療、不歧視」為主軸，與民間團體合辦社區篩檢快閃、校園講座與線上活動，推廣 U=U（測不到病毒就不具傳染力）的觀念。

en.title: 2025 World AIDS Day: testing, treatment, no discrimination
en.summary: Page for the 2025 World AIDS Day campaign (15 November to 15 December 2025): promoted anonymous testing, U=U and anti-discrimination. The campaign has ended and the page is kept as a record.
en.introMarkdown:
**This campaign ended on 15 December 2025.** The content below is kept as a record; for current services, see the section on anonymous counselling and testing for sexually transmitted infections.

For World AIDS Day 2025, Taiwan CDC chose "testing, treatment, no discrimination" as its theme and worked with community organisations on pop-up community testing, campus talks and online activities, promoting the idea of U=U (undetectable = untransmittable).
